mapper.select: select cdtype, codecd, codenm, remark, dspord, useyn from haba900t_tbl where cdtype = #{cdtype} and useyn = 'y' order by dspord

when.test: gubun != null and (gubun == 'C4' or gubun == 'C0' or gubun == 'C7' or gubun == 'C9')

choose.when:
SELECT custcd AS custcd, custcd AS codecd, custcd AS code, custnm AS custnm, custnm AS codenm, custnm AS remark, custno AS dspord, 'Y' AS useyn, ceo AS ceo, telno AS telno, address AS address FROM haba020t_tbl WHERE 1=1
AND cmpycd = #{cmpycd}
AND (custnm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR custcd LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (custnm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%') OR custcd LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%'))
ORDER BY custnm
choose.otherwise:
SELECT codecd as codecd, codecd as code, codenm as codenm, codenm as remark, dspord, useyn FROM haba900t_tbl WHERE 1=1
AND cdtype = #{gbncd}
AND (codecd LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%') OR codenm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{code}, '%'))
ORDER BY dspord
